description: An all-blocks delta (a request without b, H-7) that the server built for another base (page-title-2, for example another user) to page-b, on a snapshot of page-a. Every block is replaced, so the result is page-b and the check of H-104 accepted it (cross-user content, S6 security review F1). The binding has B = r1(page-title-2): INTEGRITY_ERROR at step 7 (H-107)
